title: Multi-class Hierarchical Question Classification for Multiple Choice Science Exams
answer_short: Starting with the syllabus for the NY Regents exam, we identified 9 coarse question categories, then through a data-driven analysis of 3 exam study guides and the 3,370 training questions, expanded the taxonomy to include 462 fine-grained categories across 6 hierarchical levels of granularity.
answer_rationale: The dataset was collected by first identifying 9 coarse question categories from the NY Regents exam syllabus, then expanding the taxonomy through a data-driven analysis of 3 exam study guides and 3,370 training questions to include 462 fine-grained categories across 6 hierarchical levels. This process is explicitly described in Text 10 (page=4, section=Questions and Classification Taxonomy).
